convention: One plan per real room, keyed by key = name @box@y. Local blocks as estate-plan.json: x from the west wall line, z from the north wall line; the inside runs .5 to w-.5. r: 0 faces +z, 90 faces +x. No doors, windows or stairs. on = index in this room's items of the table a small item stands on. record = a signature prop for one GOLEM record. Runs give kind and wall only; a and b span the wall. Hanging pieces carry the y that puts their top voxel on the ceiling.
